resources.string: June connects directly to Google Drive. Your files never pass through any third-party or developer servers.
Sync journals privately to a secure app-data folder on your Google Drive.
We don\'t run databases or servers. Your thoughts remain entirely under your control and completely private.
Used solely on your device to display your account status. The developer never sees or collects this info.
June is restricted to its own app folder. It cannot see, read, or modify any other files in your Google Drive.
